name: s5_narrow_street
description: Scenario 5: narrow street with cars parked along the right-hand kerb. The ego car drives 30 km/h in the middle of the road. An adult steps out between two parked cars (from behind them, so the car is hidden until the last moment) at 1.5 m/s and crosses the ego lane (trigger.arrivalOffsetS = 0, a collision course). The scripted driver does not react.
